name: AgroLens
comment: AgroLens offers integral recurrent agricultural monitoring for export-oriented producers, combining drones, ground stations, and a web platform. The deck positions a managed service model for Hass avocado farms at roughly USD 100 per hectare per year. Taxonomy CT-AF-007 Precision Agri Data; deck Drive id 1SL-H4P4mSW4wIyNEitwjLQCma79_MyRZ.

name: Andean Biofactories
comment: Andean Biofactories delivers community biofactory-as-a-service: modular automated production of local fortified foods to strengthen food sovereignty in highland communities, sold to mining companies via social investment budgets (deck cites roughly USD 24,000 per year per community). Taxonomy CT-AF-010 Organic & Regenerative Ag; deck Drive id 137esrBbb4nMgiEfNTudV3TfX5_8epFG0.

name: FIVRA
comment: FIVRA is a platform that generates AI-developed textile technical specification sheets to cut pre-production waste, aimed at textile entrepreneurs with limited technical knowledge; deck pricing starts around USD 4 per sheet across Starter, Basic, and Pro packages. Taxonomy CT-IN-003 Circular Economy & Clean Mfg; deck Drive id 1XBoqfBw718P4SHTV_KG8fNcTV68UT5Oq.

name: HardTech
comment: HardTech develops silicon carbide (SiC) ingot synthesis for microelectronics and integrated-circuit manufacturers, citing a patented high-temperature furnace process (USPTO 63/724,867 in deck) with lower energy use and shorter cycle time versus conventional production in deck comparisons. Taxonomy pending; deck Drive id 1kuMsv2sFItitkiHVFccNUmFyW22FZQF3.

name: Kallpa Greenz Leaders
comment: Kallpa Greenz Leaders offers sustainable, scalable agro-investment in Peru: integrated agricultural plans (deck highlights tomato) with long-term contracts, revenue share, and returns framed for passive investors and landowners with underused farmland. Taxonomy pending; deck Drive id 18o0Kt5JIVowE-mbuBrJ9DByoRsNoIpL-.

name: NanoHumi
comment: NanoHumi sells Nano-Humi, a microencapsulated solid biofertilizer (1 kg bottle) for organic and ecological farmers in southern Peru (deck list price S/. 60 per unit), positioned to regenerate degraded soil and improve yields without leaving organic management. Taxonomy CT-AF-010 Organic & Regenerative Ag; deck Drive id 1SyRZNWYEA3PDkzITHb39vpqxc89Ji01O.
